shop.title: Gem shop
shop.earn: Gems are earned by learning: lessons, streaks, achievements and the daily gift. Nothing here costs real money.
shop.cashBody: To practise with more money on the simulator. It goes in as a top-up: it doesn't count as returns or in the league.
shop.bought: Done: you have {amount} more to practise with
shop.hintBody: On single-answer questions, it removes one wrong option. It appears next to the question.
shop.livesBody: If you run out of lives, you can get them back with gems or by reviewing your mistakes.
shop.plusNote: With Plus you get unlimited lives and more questions for Lumi for €5.99 a month.
shop.notEnough: You don't have enough gems. You earn them by doing lessons and opening the daily gift.
shop.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
shop.hintAria: Remove one wrong option for {n} gems
shop.hintUsed: Hint used: one wrong option is crossed out
shop.reviewLife: Get a life back by reviewing your mistakes
shop.reviewLifeBody: Get at least one review question right and you win a life, for free.
